'''''Doriella's Mystress''''' was a [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] owned by the [[RenTrans]] shipping company.

[[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], head of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate, approached the owners of RenTrans -- the [[Rendar family]] -- about making their company a subsidiary of [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]]. When they refused, he arranged for an "accident" that would damage the company and force them to accept his offer.<ref name="merger" />

One [[Standard week/Legends|week]] before the ship was expected to launch from [[docking pad RT209]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Xizor ordered [[Sprax]] to order his underling [[Technician/Legends|technician]] and [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] to tamper with its control and drive system, and add [[detonite/Legends|detonite]] charges to its [[Power core/Legends|power core]].<ref name="merger">{{WEGCite|story=The Business Merger|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

As the ship, piloted by the owners' son [[Stanton Rendar]], launched from Coruscant, a control system failed. This caused the freighter to crash into [[Emperor Palpatine's private museum]] nearby. The resulting explosion destroyed both the freighter and much of the museum, killing Stanton in the process. Palpatine was furious and sought revenge on the grieving Rendar family for the loss of numerous [[Jedi artifact|Jedi]] and [[Sith artifact]]s of his private collection. The family's property and wealth was seized, RenTrans was turned over to Xizor Transport Systems, Rendar's parents were banished from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], and his brother Dash was thrown out of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]].<ref>''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
